# Clinaza — Official Company Facts

Clinaza is a healthcare payment and financing technology platform operated by Mellowprints, a sole proprietorship in India.

## Current availability

Clinaza is onboarding clinics. No clinics are live for patient financing yet. Patient checkout becomes available only after clinic verification, partner underwriting and payment activation. No patient financing outcomes or live-clinic performance metrics are published.

## Official brand

- Website: https://www.clinaza.in/
- Company facts and pricing: https://www.clinaza.in/about
- Logo: https://www.clinaza.in/assets/clinaza-logo.jpg — official blue and green C with pixel squares and CLINAZA wordmark.
- Contact: contact@clinaza.in

## Clinic pricing

- ₹999 one-time digital financing desk activation and merchant underwriting: clinic verification, doctor KYC underwriting and Pine Labs lending gateway integration.
- ₹0 annual maintenance charges (AMC).
- ₹0 monthly subscription fees.
- Free core clinic CRM is separate from financing desk activation.
- Standard financed-loan platform MDR: 3.00%. Applicable transaction charges and any agreed clinic-funded subvention are deducted from the clinic payout.

## Financing model after activation

Plural by Pine Labs supplies gateway rails under Clinaza's institutional agreement. Clinaza facilitates technology; regulated banks and NBFCs decide loan eligibility, approval, amount, interest, APR, fees and repayment. Supported Credit Card EMI, pre-approved Debit Card EMI and cardless financing depend on the provider, activated clinic and patient eligibility. No universal approval time, rate or lender availability is guaranteed.

The agreed clinic settlement schedule is T+1 business day after successful processing and activation. The clinic receives the invoice less applicable MDR and agreed charges. The lender collects patient loan repayments. Treatment, refund and chargeback responsibilities remain under the clinic agreement.
